adjudicated.jp: みょー。（最中）
comments: Myoo -> myou, pee. I tried thinking this as running water, but I don't see how that can be when the only place with running water seems to be the pipe on the rooftop, which I suppose taps directly into the water tower. CCA0030 has a suspiciously specific term that avoids running water, and CCC3022 also has Kiri leaving a stall without apparently flushing.

Of course, Gunjou likely has independent plumbing, and it could still be turned on (water tower, again), but then why the two oddities above? Considering the fake Alt World stuff, it might be that it does, but we're seeing it weirdly because Taichi is projecting it here even when it obviously doesn't belong. Also see CCD0014C, where the joke is certain. And I wrote nearly a kb on whether a SFX refers to pee, yay analysis! -GHS
